notes: Seat status from official precinct results for the REPUBLICAN COMMITTEEMAN and REPUBLICAN COMMITTEEWOMAN contests (vote for 1 each; the county candidate listing shows a 2-year term, so these seats are elected every even-year primary). filled = a ballot candidate received votes (no write-in total exceeded the ballot candidate anywhere). empty = no ballot candidate and zero votes cast. unknown = no ballot candidate but write-in votes were cast (including named write-ins), so a write-in may have won and accepted; the public report does not say. Precinct names are the contest titles printed in the results (Committeeman contest title used for both seats; Committeewoman titles in East Petersburg and two Hempfield districts omit the word 'District'). The results report has 241 reporting sections because Lancaster City 7-8 (0708) is reported in two parts (0708-2 CV and 0708-3 LS); their votes were combined into one 7-8 precinct, giving 240 committee districts and 480 seats. Appointments made after the primary are not captured.
